programs.title: FOX Weather Live
programs.desc: Steve Bender hosts from Studio W, the heart of fox weather, as extreme weather strikes; Steve provides real-time alerts and information to keep you and your family safe and get you ready for the next day ahead.

programs.title: Fox Weather @ Night
programs.desc: Pull an all-nighter with fox weather as our meteorologists recap the day in weather news and forecast across America for tomorrow.

programs.title: PARK'D With Abby Hornacek
programs.desc: Abby heads down to Key West and visits Dry Tortugas National Park; come along on a boat ride, a snorkeling adventure, swim with dolphins and learn how to make Key lime pie.

programs.desc: Abby explores Southern Oregon's Crater Lake National Park and its blue waters; enjoy nearby activities like old-fashioned wine stomping, zip-lining and night kayaking.

programs.desc: Waking up at 5am to the first national forecast of the day; all the latest weather news and everything one needs to prepare for the day ahead.

programs.title: Weather Command
programs.desc: Going inside the Weather Command Center for America's forecast authority for all the latest breaking weather news; tracking every storm as fox weather meteorologists, contributors and correspondents deliver real-time weather alerts and forecasting.
